captions.detailed: An immersion blender consisting of a matte black pistol-grip motor unit and a detachable silver-gray blending shaft. The motor unit features a cylindrical upper housing, a rectangular grip handle, and a speed selector dial on the rear face. The detachable shaft is composed of a long cylindrical tube ending in a protective blade guard cage at the bottom, and it connects to the motor body via a collar with side-press release buttons.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an immersion blender with a black pistol-grip motor unit, a rear speed selector dial, and a detachable gray blending shaft ending in a blade guard cage.
captions.factory: Construct the main motor body using a horizontal cylinder and a vertical box for the pistol grip. Model the speed selector dial on the back using a thin cylinder. Create the detachable blending shaft by combining a long vertical cylinder with a bottom ring and a wireframe-like blade guard cage at the end, then join the shaft assembly to the motor body using a fixed articulation joint.
